skill.displayName: Shopee-站点类目数据 | 青虎AI

llm.summary: The skill’s Shopee data lookup purpose is coherent, but it tells the agent to install and update tooling and modify the user environment with limited containment.

dimensions.detail: For a data lookup skill, the instruction to bootstrap missing dependencies rather than stop expands local environment authority beyond simply invoking an already provisioned tool.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill body instructs the agent to install @iqinghu/qhkit globally, use unpinned npx as a fallback, install or upgrade to latest packages, and download Node binaries from remote URLs or mirrors during normal use.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill gives useful limits such as asking for missing required parameters, estimating cost, getting user approval for paid calls, and capping paid calls, but one trigger example is broad enough to match generic category-comparison requests.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The Node fallback persists binaries under $HOME/.local/lib and suggests PATH changes that may be added to ~/.bashrc; token configuration is expected for the service but still stores or uses sensitive credentials.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The qhkit MCP calls, Shopee category parameters, paid-call authorization, and result handling fit the stated purpose of querying Shopee category metrics.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable letting this skill provision Node/qhkit and configure a qhkit token. Prefer installing qhkit yourself from a trusted, pinned version and avoid letting the skill modify shell startup files automatically.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] unexpected: The broad trigger phrase was confirmed in the artifact, but the surrounding Shopee and qhkit framing reduces it to an over-invocation risk rather than evidence of abuse.
[SDI-2] unexpected: The artifact does include extensive self-bootstrapping, package installation, PATH modification, and token setup; this is the main reason for Review.
[RP1] unexpected: The artifact includes an unpinned npx fallback and latest-version npm upgrade path, which leaves the executed package version mutable after review.
[RA2] unexpected: The artifact confirms user-home binary installation and PATH modification instructions; this is persistent local environment change, not a hidden backdoor.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-language framing matches the skill’s Chinese documentation and is not by itself a security concern.
